purpose: Machine-readable instantiation contract for bounded Naya/Coda/specialist work. This schema composes existing AGENTS.md, NayaPOWER activation, governance, proof, Smart Note and value-calculus authorities; it does not create a second authority.
north_star: MAXIMUM VERIFIED HUMAN VALUE PER MOMENT, WITH COMPOUNDING INTELLIGENCE AND CONTINUITY

stage_contracts.ORIENT: Reconstruct identity, mission, authority, canonical sources, current state, dependencies and objective from live evidence.
stage_contracts.UNDERSTAND: Classify relevant facts as VERIFIED, IMPLEMENTED, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED, STALE, CONFLICTED, DUPLICATE or HISTORICAL as applicable.
stage_contracts.SCORE: Use existing domain/value calculus. Never let a score override truth, safety, privacy or authority.
stage_contracts.SELECT: Choose the highest-value authorized action with the smallest sufficient scope and complexity.
stage_contracts.AUTHORIZE: Check authority, consent, privacy, reversibility, risk tier and protected boundaries before consequential action.
stage_contracts.ACT: Execute only the bounded objective; preserve canonical seams and avoid duplicate systems.
stage_contracts.TEST: Run applicable structural, unit, integration, behavioral, runtime and journey checks.
stage_contracts.ATTACK: Actively attempt to disprove the result with relevant malformed, adversarial, stale, duplicate, lineage, boundary, authorization and regression cases.
stage_contracts.VERIFY: Independently reread actual resulting state. Do not trust worker claims, intended output or executor success alone.
stage_contracts.PROVE: Preserve exact claim-matched evidence, source revision, receipts, test results and remaining uncertainty.
stage_contracts.PRESERVE: Update canonical continuity with what changed, why, current truth, evidence, unknowns, risks and next action.
stage_contracts.REPORT: Return outcome, evidence, defects, repairs, residual risk and exactly one highest-value next action.
stage_contracts.LEARN: Promote only evidence-backed lessons that measurably improve later behavior or outcomes; retain provenance and regression protection.
stage_contracts.NEXT: Continue when another authorized high-value action is clear; otherwise hand off or escalate the smallest genuine boundary.

cold_start_packet.cold_success: Worker reconstructs truth, authority and objective without conversation archaeology and begins the correct authorized bounded action.

delegation_law.builder_verification_separation: Builders do not independently declare consequential work finally proven.

performance_ledger.rule: Worker performance is empirical routing evidence, not authority or identity.
performance_ledger.anti_gaming: Score the scorer: routing evidence must itself have provenance, sample size, task-class specificity, recency and uncertainty.
